inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The loss-of-function rule paragraph (both (two) alleles must be lost — the Knudson 2-hit hypothesis) + the 15-row GENE / GENE PRODUCT / ASSOCIATED CONDITION table (APC, BRCA1/BRCA2, CDKN2A, DCC, SMAD4 (DPC4), MEN1, NF1, NF2, PTEN, RB1, TP53, TSC1, TSC2, VHL, WT1). Pure text — no figure (pdfimages: zero rasters; VLM confirmed).
inventory.kypLocation: the registry visual (the rule panel's two-hit Knudson fork + the tumor-suppressor roster as a function-family grid) + blocks[2] the table block carried verbatim

notes: The page is pure text (pdfimages: ZERO raster images; VLM census confirmed) — its two 'visuals' are the two tables themselves, each adapted as the registry visual (ORIGINAL_KYP ADAPTATION, the P16 convention: an original rule panel + classification grids, with every row carried verbatim in the note's table blocks) and nothing reproduced. No margin notes or mnemonics print on the page; the KYP memory layer is original.
